{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) — though we found 0 in the previous check
# But we'll still filter explicitly to be safe
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Confirm we have only completed orders now
print(f'Number of completed orders after filtering: {len(df_clean)}')

# Confirm no QA orders remain
print(f'QA orders remaining: {len(df_clean[df_clean["revenue"] == 999999.99])}')

# Check that revenue is now numeric
print(f'First 5 revenue values after cleaning: {df_clean["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Check channel distribution after filtering
df_channel_clean = df_clean[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts().to_frame('count')
df_channel_clean = df_channel_clean.reset_index()
print('Channel and customer segment distribution after filtering:')
print(df_channel_clean)"}
